changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Adding a nullable vet_id foreign key to visits, so a visit can record which vet attended. Nullable because existing visits have no vet, and ON DELETE SET NULL so deleting a vet does not destroy clinical history.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE visits ADD COLUMN vet_id INTEGER; ALTER TABLE visits ADD CONSTRAINT fk_visits_vet FOREIGN KEY (vet_id) REFERENCES vets (id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
